scope: Actual old CRG PLL and secondary regional MMCM/BUFIO UNISIM. Word-by-word 14bit native protocol, independently indexed original-old-A/new-B slots, input14bit full coverage, ADC differential, DAC latch/divide update model, delayed lock-safe reset, PS resets and clock loss/relock. Not SDF/PVT/PCB or analog performance proof. No extra feedback register; output edge subcycle phases intentionally differ.
